description: Requests that the KDC issue a ticket with the FORWARDABLE flag set, allowing it to be forwarded to another host on the client's behalf.
Indicates that this ticket was forwarded, or that this TGT was used to obtain a forwarded ticket.
Requests that the KDC issue a ticket with the PROXIABLE flag set, allowing a service to use it to obtain a service ticket on the client's behalf.
Indicates that this ticket is a proxy ticket.
Requests that the KDC issue a postdated ticket with the MAY-POSTDATE flag set (a ticket usable to later request an actual postdated ticket).
Requests that the KDC issue a postdated ticket, or indicates that a ticket is postdated.
Requests that the KDC issue a renewable ticket, allowing it to be renewed instead of a new one requested, up to the ticket's renew-till time.
In a TGS-REQ, indicates the second ticket provided is used to encrypt the client name and realm instead of the sub-session key (used for user-to-user authentication).
Requests that the KDC canonicalize the client and/or server principal name in the reply.
Requests that the ticket returned not reveal the client's true identity.
Requests the KDC not verify the transited field of a TGT against a hierarchy of trusted realms; the application server must then do so instead.
Indicates that a renewable ticket will be acceptable if a ticket with the requested life cannot otherwise be provided.
Requests that, instead of being encrypted in the target service's key, the ticket be encrypted in the session key of the additional ticket provided (user-to-user authentication).
In a TGS-REQ, requests renewal of a renewable ticket that is about to expire.
In a TGS-REQ, requests validation of a postdated ticket whose start time has now arrived.
